assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP's precision mapping of the cosmic microwave background transformed cosmology into a precision science and tested a coherent account of the universe's contents and history.
assessment.attribution: The mission's measurements and their interpretation were large collaborative achievements; these names represent major instrumental and theoretical contributions.
assessment.maturity: The results have been extensively checked and shaped cosmological research for decades.
uncertainties: Credit across the broad WMAP collaboration and earlier CMB work requires careful delineation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The ATLAS and CMS experiments enabled the discovery of the Higgs boson, confirming a central component of the Standard Model and opening a new experimental era.
assessment.attribution: These leaders represent the long-term construction and leadership of two immense experiments; the discovery depended on thousands of contributors.
assessment.maturity: The signal was independently observed by both experiments and its properties have since been studied extensively.
uncertainties: Recognizing a few leaders for a discovery made by two very large collaborations is an unavoidable attribution challenge.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks turned an exceptionally precise atomic transition into a practical, powerful measurement platform, with consequences for fundamental tests and timekeeping.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye made complementary foundational contributions to the clock concept and its experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The technology has been repeatedly realized and improved, with precision and applications demonstrated across laboratories.
uncertainties: The boundary between the original invention and later advances by other clock groups merits review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene revealed a striking route to correlated insulating and superconducting states and established moiré materials as a new experimental setting for quantum matter.
assessment.attribution: The theoretical prediction and landmark experimental realization are both essential to the discovery.
assessment.maturity: The phenomena have been actively investigated and extended to related systems, though the field remains young.
uncertainties: The microscopic account of superconductivity and the generality of the original results remain under study.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ultracold atoms in optical lattices made controlled quantum simulation of many-body systems experimentally possible and created a versatile way to study condensed-matter physics.
assessment.attribution: The achievement spans theoretical proposals and experimental demonstrations by several groups; the listed names cover central contributions.
assessment.maturity: The platform is well established and has produced many robust results, although its ultimate reach as a simulator is still developing.
uncertainties: The breadth of the topic makes it difficult to define a single discovery and a fair set of contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum error correction showed how quantum information can be protected in principle, changing the prospects for quantum computation and connecting information theory to fundamental physics.
assessment.attribution: These theorists made foundational, complementary contributions to codes and fault-tolerant computation.
assessment.maturity: The framework is secure and experimental demonstrations continue to advance, but large-scale fault-tolerant computation remains unrealized.
uncertainties: The prize case depends on whether the conceptual achievement alone is sufficiently complete before scalable fault tolerance is demonstrated.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Pulsar timing arrays have produced compelling evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background, extending gravitational-wave astronomy to a new frequency range.
assessment.attribution: The result is an international, multi-array effort; these names represent major contributions to the pulsar timing programs.
assessment.maturity: The evidence is strong and broadly consistent across arrays, but the background's detailed interpretation is still developing.
uncertainties: The common signal's astrophysical origin and the degree to which it is established as gravitational radiation remain under active scrutiny.
Credit among the many participating teams needs careful assessment.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Kilonova theory and observation linked neutron-star mergers to bright electromagnetic transients and provided direct evidence that such events forge heavy elements.
assessment.attribution: The names span influential theoretical predictions, radiative modeling, and observational identification.
assessment.maturity: The neutron-star merger observed with gravitational waves and light gave the field a powerful confirmation, though the population and detailed yields remain under study.
uncertainties: Credit spans many theorists, observers, and facilities, and the credited contributions may not capture the full discovery chain.
